name: dg-uposatha-app
description: Uposatha calendar as a Capacitor Android app. A thin shell around the site's page (capacitor.config.json -> server.url): the UI stays the site's; the app adds what only native can do — reminders as local notifications on the device (they arrive with the app closed), the choice of a sound as notification channels, launcher shortcuts, the app version and the store link.

scripts.sync-android: npm run build && cap sync android
